answer: Each agent first requests a TPM-sealed execution trace, a hardware-signed comet of instruction hashes bound to its unique endorsement key. The verifier replays that trace inside its own attested enclave; because sealing fuses the PCR state to physical silicon, one machine cannot multiplex a whisper of fake identities across cloned VMs without colliding on the same 2048-bit key. A challenger then demands the agent forge a fresh 30-second trace under 16 GB RAM lock, costing roughly $0.40 per attestation.
